blocks.text: Blockchain technology ek revolutionary concept (bara farq lane wala khayal) hai jo distributed ledger system (aisa hisaab ka register jis ki copy bohat se computers par ho) ke zariye mehfooz aur transparent (saaf, sab ke saamne) transactions mumkin banata hai. Yeh hissa blockchain ki basic baatein, us ke core principles aur aham components bataata hai.

blocks.explanation: Transactions ka aisa record jis ki ek jaisi copies kisi ek central authority ki bajaye network ke bohat se computers ke paas hoti hain.

items: Blockchain: distributed ledger se mehfooz aur transparent transactions.
